thread:
olivia: quick request — opened a docs PR that updates the python + ts SDK snippets for streaming and fixes a broken image path in the migration guide. can someone eyeball before i merge?

mike: linking the PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — thanks! the netlify preview is failing atm (404 on static assets) so i can't preview the rendered migration guide.

netlify-bot: Deploy failed for branch docs/pr-482 — https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/5f3a2b — error: static asset not found (status 404)

jess: I can review SDK snippets. Olivia — did you change package names or just examples?

olivia: only examples, updated import to `from redwood import RedwoodClient` and added streaming example using `client.stream_chat(...)`. Also fixed an image link from `/assets/migration/diagram.png` to `assets/migration/diagram.png` per mkdocs path rules.

mike: that relative path change is likely why Netlify still 404s — Netlify builds with `site_url` root set and absolute-leading-slash paths can break. try removing the leading `/` or set `use_directory_urls: false` in mkdocs?

olivia: i already removed the leading slash in the markdown, but CI log still shows 404. posting the mkdocs build snippet:

```
INFO    -  Building documentation...
ERROR   -  File 'docs/assets/migration/diagram.png' does not exist, skipped.
WARNING -  Static files missing: 'css/main.css'
```

tim: looking at the PR — the assets are inside `docs/_static/...` locally but the build config copies from `docs/assets`. maybe the folder move in a prior commit wasn't included in this PR.

olivia: ah — that explains it. i moved images into `docs/_static/migration/diagram.png` locally and updated markdown to `assets/migration/diagram.png` — forgot to add a tiny `mkdocs.yml` entry mapping.

mike: two quick options: 1) move the images back to `docs/assets/migration/` in this PR, or 2) add this to `mkdocs.yml`:

```yaml
extra:
  static_dir: _static

# then reference with /{{ static_dir }}/migration/diagram.png (not ideal)
```

jess: i vote move the images back into `docs/assets` for now — simpler and faster for a docs patch. i can review the python/ts snippets while you update assets.

ci-bot: GitHub Actions — docs-build (pull_request) failed on run #986: `mkdocs build` exited with code 1. Logs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions/runs/12345678

olivia: okay i'm pushing a small commit to restore `docs/assets/migration/diagram.png` and a quick `README` in `docs/assets` so CI picks it up. will ping when pushed.

(2 minutes later)

olivia: pushed fix — added asset back and updated markdown to `assets/migration/diagram.png`. should trigger a new Netlify build.

netlify-bot: Deploy started for branch docs/pr-482 — https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/5f3a2c

mike: while the build runs — jess, can you confirm the SDK snippets look idiomatic? specifically the streaming example for python: `for chunk in client.stream_chat(prompt):` — we prefer `with client.stream_chat(...) as stream:` for resource cleanup.

jess: good catch. i'll suggest that change in a review comment. also add `# pip install redwood-sdk==1.2.0` above examples to avoid confusion.

tim: small merge ops note — we have a midnight merge window for doc-only changes to avoid clashing with release deploys. if this PR is green in the next ~40 minutes we can queue it; otherwise wait until 00:00 UTC.

olivia: noted. ping me if green before midnight, otherwise i'll queue. thanks all.

netlify-bot: Deploy succeeded — https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/5f3a2c (status: 200)

mike: saw the preview — images render and the migration diagram looks good. jess left a review requesting the streaming example tweak.

jess: approved after the snippet tweak. small nit: explicitly show types in TypeScript sample for clarity.

olivia: updated examples per feedback and squashed commits. ready for merge if CI is happy.

ci-bot: GitHub Actions — docs-build (pull_request) passed on run #987.

mike: go ahead and merge during the current window — i'll do a quick smoke check after merge.

olivia: merged. thanks everyone! quick local preview instructions for anyone who wants to reproduce the Netlify build locally:

- install: `pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material``
- run local server: `mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000`
- or build: `mkdocs build --clean` and check `site/assets/` for copied images
- Docker option: `docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/docs squidfunk/mkdocs-material build`

tim: thanks — good checklist to keep in CONTRIBUTING.md too.

jess: :thumbsup:
